tools.name: find_use_case
tools.description: Describe an event (e.g. '150-guest wedding reception', 'company holiday party with remote staff', 'celebration of life') and get the matching QR Wall use-case pages, quotable descriptions, licensed screenshots/videos and a no-signup demo link.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Every QR Wall plan (Free, Premium, Professional) and one-off add-on, with prices in USD, what each includes and its limits, plus the cheapest way to cover a single event.

tools.name: get_facts
tools.description: Canonical, code-verified facts about QR Wall: product summary, plan capability matrix, how guests post, the screen, moderation, data and privacy, limits, where it fits and where it does NOT, and quick answers. Optionally narrow by topic.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Given a competitor or alternative (e.g. 'Kululu', 'Walls.io', 'Slido', 'Glip'), return QR Wall's comparison and alternatives pages with their one-paragraph answer, plus QR Wall's honest limits.

tools.name: list_demos
tools.description: Links a user can open to see QR Wall working with no sign-up — product video, live try-it wall, moderation demo, playable seasonal walls — plus the media kit per use case.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_facts · Public sink: get_facts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_facts · Public sink: get_facts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
